body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would push, pull or knock the target Prone. Response (unopposed): Reduce forced movement by 2 units and suppress that Prone effect until the Action finishes.

surges.html: The protected creature may move 1 unit after the Action.
Reduce Damage from that Action by 1.
